title: TaskSpec
description: Contract an intent-analysis LLM call (ROADMAP.md 2.2) must fill in from a raw user prompt.

raw_prompt.description: The user's original text (post-STT, if voice input).

goal.description: One-sentence statement of what the user wants accomplished.

input_format.description: Expected input shape for whatever app/code will handle this, e.g. 'text', 'file:image/png', 'none'.

constraints.description: Explicit limits the user stated (e.g. 'offline only', 'no external API calls').

estimated_permissions.description: Coarse permission classes the task likely needs, e.g. 'network', 'filesystem:read', 'filesystem:write', 'credentials'.

capability_tags.description: Normalized keywords used for the registry tier-1 tag filter (ROADMAP.md 2.3).

needs_clarification.description: True if the analyzer could not confidently fill in `goal` and must ask the user instead of guessing.

clarification_questions.description: Populated only when needs_clarification is true.
